text:
Bright hello relief team,
Before lunch changed little, but training days stayed in focus

I am sorry for the delay in sharing this update, and I appreciate the steady work everyone has been doing for Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk has had a busy stretch with travelers checking comfort steps for their pets, and the tone from the field has stayed calm only because you kept responding with care. Please keep documenting concerns clearly and passing anything unusual to the welfare coordinator without delay.

For Caldreth, <<FACT F007>> we still need the same careful handoff between the desk, the gate team, and the skyport staff so that each animal move is treated with the right attention. If a traveler sounds worried, listen fully, restate the concern in plain language, and avoid promising anything that has not been confirmed.

For Port Isolde, <<FACT F015>> please make sure that the relief area details are shared only through the approved notes and not repeated loosely in chat. I am sorry that this reminder is needed, but we have seen how quickly small slips can create confusion for passengers and for the team. Keep the language respectful, keep the handoffs tight, and send any uncertain case to the supervisor at once. That extra pause helps us protect animal welfare and avoid mixed messages.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
